content: KDE session-bus ADR-010 coverage complete: aports 1289145 (obexd/ibus/system-config-printer user-dinit, CI 40158178885); KDE list += 9 session packages; harness kde full-feature dinit 2026-10-25T03-41-55Z 77/77; log_errors WARNING sweep with 3-line allowlist; kcookiejar5 exemption; dbus_activation_env honest skip on DE-owned buses; services.go boot.d symlink /lib-or-/etc fix. Full matrix green: kde 77/77, cosmic 77/77, niri 113/113, niriWayle 109/109 dinit + 92/92 OpenRC.

Cleanup after the ADR-010 R1 amendment: dead initd-named duplicate units removed from avahi-dinit r8 and udisks2-dinit r6 (dbus-activated on demand — bus-named units org.freedesktop.Avahi/org.freedesktop.UDisks2 are the live ones, overrides alias onto them); stale harness/docs references fixed. niri dinit 19-02-10Z 113/113 confirms.
